rooms.name: The Hatching Branch
rooms.note: Cocoons on a high branch. The vista: the Lampweb glowing over the clearing below, moths circling it, and its four mooring lines running off into the dark, one to each corner of the wood. Within reach: the promise gap west to the mast (glide), the crown's bark above (claws), Tatter's failed hop, the drop east into the fall.

rooms.name: The Crown
rooms.note: Top of the hatching tree. One screen: a moonlit hollow (Long Breath, the fling's aim held twice as long) on a bark face over the branch. Within reach: the hollow, a wick to snuff, a look at all four lines from above.

rooms.name: The Long Fall
rooms.note: The drop beside the web. A firefly sign flashes on the way down; the web's heart glows through the east wall. Within reach: the sign, two wicks to fling off (or fall past), the spokes' ledge one jump too high (double jump), the bark walls (claws: the climb back to the hatch).

rooms.name: The Clearing under the Web
rooms.note: The hub: a round clearing between four old trees, the Lampweb strung over it, the great lamp at its heart, dead moths in the strands. A bench at the roots. Nine ways: the fall (up, claws), the heart (keys:4), the bough road and the root gate (west), the silk arch and the cap steps (east), the moth-stone, Tatter's roost, the drain (opened from below). Each cut line sags one quarter of the web and lets real moonlight into that side of the clearing. Within reach: the bench, Tatter, the stone, two circling-moth wicks on the low strands.

rooms.name: The Web's Heart
rooms.note: The Weaver's arena: the great lamp in the web's middle, sunk within reach of the clearing once all four lines are cut. The Weaver comes down to defend it (lab-weaver).

rooms.name: The Moon Gate
rooms.note: Behind the fallen heart: a hole torn through the web to the open sky and the valley of lamps. The area's exit. Within reach: the first unbroken view of the moon, the swarm streaming east.

rooms.name: The Moth-stone
rooms.note: A carved stone in a root hollow off the clearing: reading it draws the wood's map, the four lines marked, the rooms faint. One screen. Within reach: the stone, a wick over it, the road above through a crack.

rooms.name: Tatter's Roost
rooms.note: Tatter, torn wing, sits where freed moths gather before they leave. Counts them, and at 40 / 80 / 120 freed gives a moth-heart shard, the lamp layer of the map, a second shard. Within reach: Tatter, the freed moths' cloud, a view up the east strands.

rooms.name: The Spokes
rooms.note: Walking the web's outer threads over the heart: strands that grab, danglers under the rim, the great lamp's glare below. A moth-heart shard at the far end. Within reach: the shard, two danglers, strands to cut, a fling off a rim wick. Reached from the husk wall (glide) or the fall (double jump).

rooms.name: The Drain
rooms.note: Where the clearing's dead moths wash down between the four trees' roots. A grate at the top opens into the clearing from below (the shortcut home from the deep ring). Within reach: the grate, carriers hauling husks, a wick at the bottom.

rooms.name: The Bough Road
rooms.note: NW, the Boughs (wind, sway, hawkers). A great fallen limb from the clearing west to the old pine. A hawker works the orbit of a swinging wick halfway. Within reach: the hawker, the swinging wick (fling over a thorn gap), the bark floor down into the beetle hollow, the mast's foot, the swing above.

rooms.name: The Mast
rooms.note: A dead fir, lamps hung up its height: climb it by flinging wick to wick. Junction of the Boughs (6 ways). Within reach: the lamp ladder, a hawker at the top, the knot (claws), the nest (double jump), the windfall's swing (glide), the hatching branch across the promise gap (glide).

rooms.name: The Windward Limbs
rooms.note: High bare limbs west from the mast's top, wind gusting, the NW line running overhead toward the pine. Within reach: two wicks on silk, a hawker pair, the line itself to follow, the high twig (double jump), the swing below (drop).

rooms.name: The Old Pine (NW mooring)
rooms.note: Far NW corner. A bough snaps behind her as she drops onto the pine. The NW line is tied round its trunk at a lamp: snuff the lamp, cut the line, it whips away toward the centre, the web's NW quarter sags, moonlight falls on her: wings (glide). No way out but the glide: across the thorn hollow to the road's end, or off the mid-bough into the swing. Within reach later: the taproot down into the burrows (claws).

rooms.name: The Lamp Swing
rooms.note: A tall gap between the pine and the mast where lamps swing on long silk. Fling chain across with a hawker diving the orbit; a fall lands on the road. Within reach: three swinging wicks, a hawker, the pine's mid-bough across the gap (seen; glided only from the pine), the limbs above.

rooms.name: The Windfall
rooms.note: Under the hatching branch: thorns below, wicks hung in a ring, two hawkers. Glide in off the mast; a fling-and-glide gauntlet to a moth-heart shard; drop out onto the road. Within reach: the gauntlet, the shard, the hawkers, the fall's wall (heard, not crossed).

rooms.name: The Hawkers' Nest
rooms.note: A ledge off the mast's top one jump too high. One screen: the nest, a hawker that defends it, a moth-heart shard. Double jump.

rooms.name: The Knot-hole
rooms.note: A knot-hole in the mast's bark, seen from its top lamp: the face beside it slides until claws. One screen: the face, the hole, a moonlit hollow (Quick Wings: beat free of a grab in 2).

rooms.name: The High Twig
rooms.note: A twig over the limbs' west end, one jump too high, the NW line's knot in view below. One screen: the ledge, a wick, a moth-heart shard. Double jump.

rooms.name: The Root Gate
rooms.note: SW, the Burrows (dark, close; beetles and carriers). The clearing's west-low door: a root arch, a carrier trail across the floor, a wick at the door. Within reach: the carriers, the wick, the bench burrow, the galleries' bark floor, the sink.

rooms.name: The Sink
rooms.note: A root shaft dropping into the dark. At its bottom a black pit to the west, the den's glow beyond it: a glide too long for a jump. Junction (6 ways). Within reach: two wicks on the way down, the hoard ledge (double jump), the cache crack (claws), the pit (glide), the beetle hollow.

rooms.name: The Old Burrback's Den (SW mooring)
rooms.note: Far SW corner, under everything. Glide in over the pit (no way back). The old burrback sleeps on a carpet of wings round the SW line's lamp. Fight it (its slam, roll and taproot phases), cut the line: the moon column falls down the taproot: claws. The only way out is up the taproot.

rooms.name: The Pine's Taproot
rooms.note: The old pine's root, running from the den straight up to the NW mooring. Claws only: faces, a rest ledge, a dangler in a root-hole, a wick at a face's end. Comes out in the pine where she got her wings: the two corners fold together. Within reach: the faces, the dangler, the wick, carvings of moths climbing.

rooms.name: The Beetle Hollow
rooms.note: Under the road's bark floor: two burrbacks asleep under wicks (light wakes them; snuff and they sleep), a juvenile on the floor. Within reach: the beetles, the two wicks, the road above, the sink east.

rooms.name: The Dry Burrow
rooms.note: A dry burrow off the gate: a rest, out of the carriers' trail. One screen.

rooms.name: The Hoard Ledge
rooms.note: A ledge in the sink's wall one jump too high: a carrier's hoard with a moth-heart shard in it. One screen. Double jump.

rooms.name: The Ant Galleries
rooms.note: Carrier trails in the dark, rotten bark floors stacked down, a wick at each landing (snuffed, the carriers go under). At the bottom a dark gap over the drowned roots. Within reach: three carrier trails, three bark floors, two wicks, the cache crack (claws), the gap (glide).

rooms.name: The Crack
rooms.note: A crack between the sink and the galleries, its walls bark: climbable only with claws, from either side. One screen: a moonlit hollow (Keen Blade, +20 px snuff reach).

rooms.name: The Drowned Roots
rooms.note: The deep ring: an old flood channel under the burrows, mud and dead moths, running east to the drain. Glide in over the galleries' gap. Within reach: two carriers, a wick, a sign, the drain east.

rooms.name: The Silk Arch
rooms.note: NE, the Silk (still, hushed, hanging; danglers and orb webs). A fallen log draped in silk from the clearing east. A dangler over the only wick; a first small orb web across the way. Within reach: the dangler, the web to cut, the wick, the hangings ahead.

rooms.name: The Hangings
rooms.note: A tall silk-hung hollow, threads from top to bottom, wrapped moths swaying. Climb by flinging between wicks among the threads, danglers on the way. Junction (7 ways). Within reach: the wick ladder, three danglers, the silk hole (claws), the roof (double jump), the orb gallery and the husk wall (glide), the larder's mouth across the top (glide).

rooms.name: The Larder (NE mooring)
rooms.note: Far NE corner. Glide across the hangings' top into the silk sack's mouth (no way back by gliding). Wrapped moths hang inside; the NE line is tied to a lamp wrapped in silk. Cut it: the web's NE quarter sags, moonlight through the sack: double jump. The only way out is up through the mouth, one jump too high.

rooms.name: The Hangings' Roof
rooms.note: Above the hangings' top wick, one jump too high. One screen: a moonlit hollow (Sharp Wings, a fling's launch cuts silk).

rooms.name: The Orb Gallery
rooms.note: Three great orb webs, each with its weaver, under the larder. Glide in from the hangings; cut a way through or snuff each web's wick and let it slacken. Within reach: three webs, three weavers, two wicks, the shelter, the drip below.

rooms.name: The Moth Shelter
rooms.note: A dry hollow off the gallery where a few moths shelter in the dark: a rest. One screen.

rooms.name: The Husk Wall
rooms.note: A wall of moth husks wrapped in silk, the Weaver's old larder, between the hangings and the web's rim. Glide across from the hangings. Within reach: danglers among the husks, a wick, the spokes west onto the web.

rooms.name: The Silk Hole
rooms.note: A cocoon in a bark hollow on the hangings' west face: the face slides until claws. One screen: the face, the cocoon, a moth-heart shard.

rooms.name: The Drip
rooms.note: Where the silk gives way to fungus: the cross-link from the Silk down to the Capwood. Wet, dripping, a dangler over glow-caps. Within reach: the dangler, a cap to bounce, a wick, both quarters' sounds.

rooms.name: The Cap Steps
rooms.note: SE, the Capwood (soft, bouncy, false glow-caps; juvenile beetles and lampwings). Shelf fungus steps east from the clearing, a juvenile beetle, a first small bounce cap. At the end, a gap over glowing toadstools to the bounce well: a glide. Within reach: the beetle, the cap, the bench, the puffball (claws), the gap.

rooms.name: The Bounce Well
rooms.note: A hollow stump full of bounce caps, up and down. The SE mooring's chamber opens high on the far wall over thorns, one jump too high from the top cap. Within reach: caps of three heights, a lampwing over a wick, the toadstool hall, the mire at the bottom, the stump's window (double jump).

rooms.name: The Toadstool Hall
rooms.note: Glowing toadstools in a ring (false light: lampwings come to them). Within reach: two lampwings, the toadstools to cut dark, a wick, the drip up, the seedfall down.

rooms.name: The Seedfall
rooms.note: Seed-cases rain from a burst pod; pogo down them over thorns. At the bottom the stump's bark side face (claws) into the mooring. Within reach: the seed-cases, a juvenile beetle, the spore ledge (claws), the mooring's side face (claws).

rooms.name: The Drowned Stump (SE mooring)
rooms.note: Far SE corner. A rotten stump in a ring of glow-caps; the SE line is tied to a lamp in it, a lampwing pair guarding. Cut it: the last quarter sags, and the whole web sinks over the clearing. A moth-heart shard in the stump. Reached by the stump's window (double jump) or its side face (claws): the one corner with two ways in.

rooms.name: The Spore Ledge
rooms.note: A bark face beside the seedfall, sliding until claws. One screen: the face, a glow-cap, a moth-heart shard.

rooms.name: The Puffball Rest
rooms.note: Under the steps, a dry puffball: a rest. One screen.

rooms.name: The Root Shelf
rooms.note: Under the steps' west end, a root face that slides until claws. One screen: a moonlit hollow (Night Eyes: each room's unseen lamps on the map).

rooms.name: The Mire
rooms.note: The deep ring's east half: soft mud, sunk caps, a juvenile beetle, from the bounce well's bottom to the drain. Within reach: the beetle, a sunk cap, a sign, the drain's grate up into the clearing.

links.note: the drop off the branch's end
a ledge one jump too high
the heart sinks within reach when all four lines are cut
the drain's grate, opened from below
the glide across the thorn hollow
off the pine's mid-bough into the lamps
